verdict.rationale: Plain-language guidance is a fair question for a government administrative portal like ANEF, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that a keyless agent gets a ~3 KB JavaScript shell from the ANEF host and a Cloudflare challenge from the parent ministry. Nothing in the pack shows published step-by-step explainers, so the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the probes could not see any content at all, rather than confirming that guidance is absent.
